referents.why: 'Him' (autou) is the one accused, the object of 'accuse'. The builder's w4 is the accusers, the subject of the verb, not the object.

links.why: This verse has no clause cl2. The verse-opening kai has no host inside the verse; a link across the verse boundary is the episode level, not a clause link.
